A '''systems analyst''' was a position held by [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lomina Argo]] and [[Valsi Nocurja]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|jediwatch/1337_1.html|Jedi Refuse to Hand Over Baby Ludi}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The title "Systems Analyst" was first mentioned in [[2002]] in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 46|Volume 531, Issue 46]] of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News feed]]. The title was mentioned in an article entitled "Jedi Refuse to Hand Over Baby Ludi" created by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="Hnn" />
